error[ZBX-E0210]: a --bind or --secret source can't be used
  while  looking at the source of --bind
  cause  --bind /srv/missing: it does not exist
  path   /srv/missing
  fix    zbx never makes a source: make it, or check the spelling
  more   zbx explain E0210
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0210.html
